q: Swachh Bharat Mission was launched on…
x: On Gandhi Jayanti, 2014. The first target was an open-defecation-free India by 2 October 2019.

q: Which was the first Indian state to be declared open-defecation free (ODF)?
x: Sikkim was first. Himachal Pradesh and Kerala followed.

q: "ODF" in Swachh Bharat stands for…
x: A village is ODF when nobody uses open fields as a toilet.

q: India's first bullet train will run between…
x: About 508 km, built with help from Japan.

q: Which country is helping India build its first bullet train line?
x: It uses Japan's Shinkansen technology and a cheap Japanese loan.

q: Beti Bachao, Beti Padhao was launched in 2015 at…
x: 22 January 2015, at Panipat. Haryana had a very low number of girls per 1,000 boys.

q: A Sukanya Samriddhi account can be opened for a girl below the age of…
x: It is a savings scheme for a girl child, under Beti Bachao, Beti Padhao.

q: PM Ujjwala Yojana (2016) gives poor women…
x: Clean cooking fuel in place of wood and coal smoke.

q: The aim of PM Awas Yojana is…
x: Housing for All. It has an urban part and a gramin (rural) part.

q: Atal Pension Yojana is mainly meant for…
x: It gives a fixed pension of ₹1,000 to ₹5,000 a month after age 60.

q: PM Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana gives…
x: Jeevan Jyoti = life cover. Suraksha Bima = accident cover. Both are ₹2 lakh.

q: PM Suraksha Bima Yojana covers…
x: Accident cover of ₹2 lakh for a very small yearly premium.

q: Stand-Up India (2016) gives bank loans to…
x: Loans from ₹10 lakh to ₹1 crore to start a new business.

q: National Startup Day is observed on…
x: Startup India was launched on 16 January 2016.

q: The logo of Make in India is a…
x: Make in India was launched on 25 September 2014 to boost factories in India.

q: The Smart Cities Mission (2015) chose how many cities?
x: 100 cities, picked through a competition.

q: AMRUT is a mission mainly for…
o: Water supply and sewerage in cities
x: Atal Mission for Rejuvenation and Urban Transformation (2015).

q: Jal Jeevan Mission (2019) promises…
o: A tap water connection to every rural home
x: Its slogan is Har Ghar Jal.

q: PM Fasal Bima Yojana (2016) is a scheme for…
x: Farmers pay a small premium and get money if the crop fails.

q: The Soil Health Card tells a farmer…
o: Which nutrients the soil lacks and how much fertiliser to use
The date of the next rain
x: Launched in 2015 at Suratgarh, Rajasthan.

q: e-NAM is…
o: An online market for farm produce
x: Electronic National Agriculture Market (2016). It links mandis across India.

q: PM SVANidhi (2020) gives small loans to…
x: Started after the Covid lockdown to help street sellers restart work.

q: PM Vishwakarma (2023) is meant for…
x: Carpenters, blacksmiths, potters and others get training, tools and cheap loans.

q: PM Surya Ghar: Muft Bijli Yojana (2024) supports…
x: Homes with rooftop solar can get up to 300 units of free power a month.

q: "One Nation, One Ration Card" lets a person…
o: Take ration from any fair price shop in India
Pay one tax for all goods
x: It helps migrant workers get their food grain where they work.

q: The Mid-Day Meal scheme was renamed in 2021 as…
x: PM POSHAN gives a hot cooked meal in government schools.

q: The National Food Security Act was passed in…
x: It gives cheap food grain as a legal right to about two-thirds of the people.

q: Antyodaya Anna Yojana gives the poorest families how much food grain a month?
x: Started in 2000 for the poorest of the poor. Other ration card families get 5 kg per person.

q: The Kisan Credit Card scheme began in…
x: It gives farmers quick short-term loans for seeds and fertiliser.

q: Who is called the father of the Green Revolution in India?
x: Swaminathan in India; Norman Borlaug in the world.

q: The White Revolution is linked to…
x: Led by Verghese Kurien through Operation Flood (1970).

q: The Blue Revolution is about…
x: Blue = fish. Yellow = oilseeds. White = milk.

q: The Yellow Revolution is about…
x: Mustard, groundnut and other oilseeds.

q: Odisha's KALIA scheme (2018) was started to help…
x: Krushak Assistance for Livelihood and Income Augmentation. It also covered landless farm workers.

q: Odisha's Mamata scheme gives money to…
x: Started in 2011 so that mothers can rest and eat well.

q: Mission Shakti in Odisha works through…
x: Started in 2001. Lakhs of women's groups get loans and work.

q: A "Lakhpati Didi" is a self-help group woman who…
o: Earns at least ₹1 lakh a year
Has ₹1 lakh in a fixed deposit
x: A central target under the rural livelihoods mission.

q: The digital rupee (e₹) is issued by…
x: It is India's central bank digital currency, started as a pilot in 2022.

q: On 8 November 2016, which notes were demonetised?
x: They stopped being legal money from midnight.

q: Farming, fishing and mining belong to which sector of the economy?
x: Primary = taken from nature. Secondary = factories. Tertiary = services.

q: Factories and construction belong to the…
x: The secondary sector turns raw material into goods.

q: Banking, transport and teaching are part of the…
x: Tertiary means services. It gives more than half of India's GDP.

q: GNP is equal to GDP plus…
x: GDP counts what is made inside the country. GNP adds what Indians earn abroad and removes what foreigners earn here.

q: "National Income" in India means…
o: Net National Product at factor cost
Gross Domestic Product at market price
x: NNP at factor cost = GNP minus depreciation minus net indirect taxes.

q: Who made the first estimate of India's national income?
x: In 1868. V.K.R.V. Rao made the first scientific estimate (1931-32).

q: India's national income figures are prepared by the…
x: NSO, under the Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation.

q: India's financial year runs from…
x: The Union Budget is presented on 1 February for the year starting 1 April.

q: The separate Railway Budget was merged with the Union Budget from…
x: The same year the Budget date moved to 1 February.

q: A tax whose rate goes up as income goes up is a…
x: Income tax in India is progressive: richer people pay a higher rate.

q: Customs duty is charged on…
o: Goods brought into or sent out of the country
x: It is an indirect tax and is outside GST.

q: The Lorenz curve shows…
x: The Gini coefficient is worked out from it. 0 = full equality, 1 = full inequality.

q: The Phillips curve links…
x: When unemployment is low, inflation tends to be high.

q: The Laffer curve links…
x: Beyond a point, a higher tax rate brings in less money.

q: Engel's law says that as a family's income rises, the share it spends on food…
x: Poor families spend most of their income on food; rich families a small part.

q: The rate at which the RBI borrows money from banks is the…
x: Repo: RBI lends to banks. Reverse repo: RBI takes money from banks.

q: The State Bank of India was earlier called the…
x: The Imperial Bank became SBI in 1955.

q: How many banks were nationalised in 1969?
x: 14 in 1969 under Indira Gandhi, and 6 more in 1980.

q: Regional Rural Banks were started in…
x: To give loans to small farmers and village workers.

q: NABARD was set up in…
x: On the advice of the Sivaraman Committee. Head office: Mumbai.

q: SIDBI gives loans mainly to…
x: Small Industries Development Bank of India (1990), head office Lucknow.

q: SEBI got legal (statutory) powers in…
x: Set up in 1988; given powers by the SEBI Act, 1992. Head office: Mumbai.

q: Which is the oldest stock exchange in Asia?
x: BSE, started in 1875.

q: The Sensex is made of how many company shares?
x: Sensex (BSE) = 30. Nifty (NSE) = 50.

q: In the share market, a "bull" is a person who expects prices to…
x: Bull = prices up. Bear = prices down.

q: The economic reforms of 1991 are known by the letters LPG. They stand for…
x: Prime Minister P.V. Narasimha Rao and Finance Minister Manmohan Singh.

q: Who was the Finance Minister when the 1991 reforms began?
x: Under Prime Minister P.V. Narasimha Rao.

q: When a government officially lowers the value of its currency against others, it is called…
x: It makes exports cheaper. India devalued the rupee in 1949, 1966 and 1991.

q: A general fall in prices over time is called…
x: Deflation is the opposite of inflation.

q: Inflation caused by a rise in the cost of raw material or wages is…
x: Costs push prices up. Demand-pull is when buyers have too much money.

q: Minimum Support Prices are recommended by the…
o: Commission for Agricultural Costs and Prices
x: CACP recommends; the Cabinet Committee on Economic Affairs announces.

q: Which is a Kharif crop?
x: Kharif crops are sown with the monsoon (June–July): rice, maize, cotton.

q: Which is a Rabi crop?
x: Rabi crops are sown in winter and cut in spring: wheat, gram, mustard.

q: Watermelon and cucumber grown in the short summer season are called…
x: Zaid is the short season between Rabi and Kharif.

q: India is the world's largest producer of…
x: India has been first in milk for many years.

q: Farm workers who have no work for some months of the year suffer from…
x: Work is there only in sowing and harvest seasons.

q: The short gap when a person is between two jobs is called…
x: It is short and normal in any economy.

q: The first complete census of India was held in…
x: 1872 was a first attempt under Lord Mayo; 1881, under Lord Ripon, was the first full one.

q: GST is a…
x: The tax goes to the state where the goods are finally used.

q: Selling the government's shares in public sector companies is called…
x: It is handled by DIPAM in the Finance Ministry.

q: The Life Insurance Corporation of India (LIC) was set up in…
x: Life insurance was nationalised in 1956.

q: Who designed the rupee symbol (₹)?
x: Adopted in 2010. It mixes the Devanagari "र" and the Roman "R".

q: At which of these places are currency notes printed?
x: Notes: Nashik, Dewas, Mysuru, Salboni. Coins: Mumbai, Kolkata, Hyderabad, Noida.

q: PM Gati Shakti (2021) is a…
x: It joins road, rail, port and airport planning on one digital map.

q: Under the PLI scheme, companies get money from the government for…
x: Production Linked Incentive: the reward is tied to extra sales of India-made goods.

q: Mission Indradhanush (2014) is about…
x: It aims at full immunisation against preventable diseases.

q: Jan Aushadhi Kendras sell…
x: Generic medicines work the same as branded ones but cost far less.

q: The National Education Policy 2020 replaced the 10+2 school system with…
x: Foundational 5, preparatory 3, middle 3 and secondary 4 years.

q: UDAN is a scheme to…
o: Make air travel cheap and link small towns
x: Ude Desh ka Aam Nagrik (2016).

q: Sagarmala is a programme to develop…
x: Sagarmala = ports. Bharatmala = highways.

q: Bharatmala is a programme to build…
x: A national highway-building plan started in 2017.

q: Namami Gange is a mission to…
o: Link the Ganga and the Kaveri
x: Launched in 2014 as a flagship programme.

q: The BHIM payments app is named after…
x: Bharat Interface for Money, launched on 30 December 2016.

q: Under SVAMITVA, villagers get property cards after their land is mapped using…
x: Launched in 2020. The card can be used to get a bank loan.

q: PM-JANMAN (2023) is aimed at…
x: PVTGs are the most backward tribal groups. Odisha has 13, the most in India.

q: Which state has the largest number of Particularly Vulnerable Tribal Groups?
x: Odisha has 13 of India's 75 PVTGs, such as the Bonda, Dongria Kondh and Juang.

q: POSHAN Abhiyaan was launched on 8 March 2018 at…
x: It fights stunting, under-nutrition and anaemia in children and women.

q: Anganwadi centres work under which scheme, started in 1975?
x: Integrated Child Development Services, for children under 6 and mothers.

q: ASHA workers are village-level…
x: Accredited Social Health Activists, started under the National Rural Health Mission (2005).

q: PM Gram Sadak Yojana (2000) builds…
x: Started under Atal Bihari Vajpayee.

q: Sending subsidy money straight into a person's bank account is called…
x: DBT cuts out middlemen and fake names.
